items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.eks_subnet1)
items.issue: Public subnet for EKS due to automatic public IP assignment
items.remediation: Set the subnet attribute `map_public_ip_on_launch = false` and use private subnets for EKS nodes and cluster networking.

items.known: CKV_AWS_37 Ensure Amazon EKS control plane logging is enabled for all log types (resource aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster)
items.issue: EKS control plane logging not enabled
items.remediation: Add an `enabled_cluster_log_types` attribute to the `aws_eks_cluster` resource and enable appropriate logs such as `["api", "audit", "authenticator", "controllerManager", "scheduler"]`.
